title: Fix the Invalid Downcast
description: The program should store different Shape subclasses in an array and process them by their actual type.
expectedBehavior: The program should only cast an array element to Circle when it is actually a Circle instance.
actualProblem: shapes[1] actually holds a Square object, not a Circle. Casting it to Circle compiles fine (since both extend Shape) but fails at runtime with a ClassCastException, because the object's real type doesn't match the cast.
explanation: Casting a reference to a more specific subclass only succeeds at runtime if the object's actual type matches (or is a subclass of) the target type. Checking with instanceof before casting avoids a ClassCastException.
